text: Figure 7.16: E2E EventProtection [TPS_MANI_03130] Standardized E2EProfileConfiguration.profileName values⌈ The E2EProfileConfiguration.profileName that is referenced by an End2EndEventProtectionProps can have the following values that are standard- ized by AUTOSAR: PROFILE_04, PROFILE_05, PROFILE_06, PROFILE_07, PRO- FILE_11, PROFILE_22.⌋(RS_MANI_00028) [TPS_MANI_03131] Non-Standardized E2EProfileConfiguration.profile- Name values⌈ The values for the profileName of E2EProfileConfiguration mentioned in [TPS_MANI_03130] are standardized and reserved for being used in the way the AUTOSAR standard foresees. PROFILE_01 and PROFILE_02 are also re- served by AUTOSAR but excluded for usage in Adaptive AUTOSAR. In addition, it is positively possible to use other than the standardized values for the profileName.⌋ (RS_MANI_00028) [constr_3380] End2EndEventProtectionProps shall not reference an event and a notifier at the same time ⌈ The End2EndEventProtectionProps ele- ment shall reference either an event or a notifier.⌋() 239 of 458 — AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL — Document ID 713: AUTOSAR_TPS_ManifestSpecification
